content: This distribution highlights a unique customer demand pattern where high-net-worth individuals and private collectors drive the market for specialized transport services. The ability to navigate these complex supply chain conditions while maintaining cost-efficiency and reliable service delivery separates the market leaders from smaller, less resilient operators [53] . Additionally, localized market momentum, occasionally spurred by factors such as inventory restocking and rebounding consumer demand, necessitates dynamic transport configurations that can scale rapidly in response to market signals [51] .
